title: SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion
tagline: Immersive player thoughts for game events, status changes, and supported mods.
description:
SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion is an SKSE plugin that turns game events,
status changes, notifications, and events from supported mods into immersive
SkyrimNet player thoughts. (ASDF)

This Hub entry links to the complete mod download. The full mod is required
because it contains the native SKSE DLL, ESP, Papyrus scripts, configuration,
and SkyrimNet trigger definitions.

Download and install the latest release with your mod manager.

List of mods that may benefit to varying degrees from the plugin: YPS fashion, MME Milk mod, Advanced Nudity Detection, SLSF, Battlefuck, BodySearch, Unforgiving Devices / Unforgiving Skyrim, Devious Followers, SLAC, SL Survival 0.685 Beta SE, STA v4.8 BETA SE, The Ancient Profession, Jailrape, Licenses - Player Oppression, Apropos 2, iNeed, RND and some elements from basic Skyrim.
The detailed links can be found in the README on the GitHub page.

changelog:
See full changelog on the GitHub.
Short summary here:
Better timing, fewer repeated comments, clearer equipment names, and additional bathing and license thoughts. Changes since 0.7.2:

## New and improved thoughts

- Added a thought when the player starts bathing, with a 180-second cooldown.
- Added expiration thoughts for weapon, magic, armor, bikini, clothing, crafting, and trading licenses, travel permits, and life insurance. These use the existing shared license-thought cooldown.
- Added a player thought for the Devious Devices plug-moan broadcast.
- Equipment names in armor-activation and AND transparency/flashing prompts now omit bracketed annotations and standalone Roman numerals I through VIII, reducing awkward spoken item labels.
- Furniture thoughts are now eligible from the first use, without an initial cooldown caused by plugin startup.

## Less repetition and better timing

- Lockpick replenishment thoughts now trigger only when you previously had three or fewer lockpicks, instead of fewer than 20. Replenishment and last-three-lockpicks thoughts each have a separate 180-second cooldown; running out of lockpicks still triggers an immediate thought.
- AND nudity-change thoughts now wait at least 30 seconds after loading a game and have a 40-second cooldown to reduce repeated comments during clothing changes.
- Fixed SLAC player-scene stage timing: stage thoughts now wait 40 seconds after the scene starts and at least 40 seconds between subsequent comments. Nearby NPC scene starts and endings each have a separate 180-second cooldown.
- Fixed slap and grope notification cooldowns incorrectly sharing the timer used for approaching SLAC creatures. Slap and grope thoughts now use their own shared 30-second cooldown.
- Added separate 120-second cooldowns for the application and removal of the Licenses magic-suppression effect.
- Increased the cooldown between Battle Fuck stripping-stage thoughts from 20 to 40 seconds.
